Dr Alex Rivera

Clinical Psychologist and Trainer

Dr Alex Rivera is a clinical psychologist based in Sydney, Australia. For the past 12 years she has trained psychologists, counsellors and social workers in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, a practical approach that helps people handle difficult thoughts and feelings and act on what matters to them.
